description: A shell script for benchmarking an Android application, involving device setup, user interface interactions, performance measurement (CPU, memory, graphics), and result aggregation.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help information for script usage.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the system.

methods.name: adb_cmd
methods.description: Executes adb with optional device serial argument.

methods.name: dump_ui
methods.description: Dumps the current UI hierarchy to an XML file.

methods.name: ui_has
methods.description: Checks if a UI pattern exists in the current view hierarchy.

methods.name: wait_for_pattern
methods.description: Waits until a UI pattern appears or timeout occurs.

methods.name: ensure_connected
methods.description: Verifies the app is in a connected state.

methods.name: ensure_screen_online
methods.description: Ensures the app's screen is online by UI interactions.

methods.name: ensure_chat_online
methods.description: Ensures the chat interface is online by UI interactions.

methods.name: capture_mem
methods.description: Captures memory info for the app.

methods.name: summarize_cpu
methods.description: Calculates and logs CPU usage statistics.

methods.name: summarize_gfx
methods.description: Analyzes and logs graphics performance metrics.

methods.name: measure_launch
methods.description: Tests app launch times under different conditions.

methods.name: run_screen_benchmark
methods.description: Performs performance testing of the screen rendering.

methods.name: run_chat_benchmark
methods.description: Performs performance testing of the chat interface.
